metadata.purpose: Deprecated exact alias of exhaustAll: flatten only the currently admitted inner Observable; ignore outer arrivals while busy.

conditions: Only an admitted inner contributes values; arrivals during active inner are discarded without subscription.
Outer completion waits for the current admitted inner; error/cancellation release current and outer subscriptions.
Alias equality is verified against the pinned RxJS 7.8.2 exports and actual runtime tests.

scope.parameters: Observable-valued outer source; no user projection
scope.callbacks: No user callback. A deterministic identity microstep maps an admitted outer source token to itself without time advancement or throwing.
scope.time: No clock or scheduler is created. Outer and inner sources supply time; same-time delivery order is explicit in the input sequence.
scope.reentrancy: Non-reentrant reactions with synchronous projection outcomes. Exact teardown traces assume source initialization has returned before terminal events.
exclusions: The identity microstep is a modeling refinement of the implementation, not an actual callback or a scheduling boundary.
Arbitrary ObservableInput conversion, reentrant source/observer/finalizer behavior and synchronous nested teardown equivalence are outside the exact-trace profile.
Invalid concurrency, throwing observers, and producer-abort guarantees are out of scope.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire one outer subscription; no projection or inner subscription before an accepted outer value.

ownership.sharing: No sharing or replay introduced. Each result subscription owns its counter, active-inner bindings and queue; an inner producer may itself be shared.
ownership.reset: Fresh bookkeeping per result subscription. Closed has no admissible events. Payloads and source tokens are retained by reference.

resources.owner: this result subscription; generation is its admission index
external projection binding; generation correlates the invocation

dispatch.actionSemantics: Commit next state, then interpret the ordered actions. A return is resolved before the next external input. Never replace RxJS delivery with an implicit event FIFO.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between fully resolved reactions; release the outer if still open and all active inners; discard queued values without completing.
Outer completion is not cancellation of admitted or queued inner work.

rules.nextState: outer open with index zero and no active inners or queued values
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. Subscription connects to the outer source. Pipeline construction alone starts no identity conversion or inner execution.

rules.guard: a concurrency slot is available and the index can advance
actions: request one projection with the input and admission index
rules.nextState: one pending projection; index advanced once
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. An accepted outer value invokes the identity conversion once with that value and the next zero-based admission index. The returned inner source is subscribed only after identity conversion succeeds.

rules.nextState: retain the current inner and index; keep no queued copy
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. While an inner is active, ignore new outer values completely. They neither invoke the identity conversion nor consume an index, and they are not saved for later.

rules.guard: matching invocation with resume=Active; result is identical to pending inner source
actions: subscribe the returned source under the pending invocation generation
rules.nextState: new inner admitted; no outer value emitted directly
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. A successful identity conversion starts its inner subscription. The outer input itself is not forwarded; values come from the admitted inner.

rules.guard: the notification belongs to an active inner generation
rules.nextState: retain the same active set and queue
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. Values from admitted active inners are forwarded unchanged in actual delivery order.

rules.guard: the error belongs to an active inner generation
actions: release all owned subscriptions and discard queued values
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. An active inner error ends the whole result, including the outer subscription and other active inners.

actions: release the open outer and active inners; discard the queue without notifying downstream
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. Downstream cancellation unsubscribes from the outer and every active inner. It neither completes the result nor projects queued values.

rules.nextState: remove that inner and keep waiting
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. An inner completing does not complete the result while the outer is still open. Wait for more outer values or other active inners.

rules.guard: the notification belongs to an active inner generation
rules.nextState: retain the same active set and queue
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. After the outer completes, values from remaining inners continue to flow until those inners finish.

rules.guard: the error belongs to an active inner generation
actions: release all owned subscriptions and discard queued values
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. An inner error while draining still ends the result immediately; other inner work and any queued values are discarded.

actions: release the open outer and active inners; discard the queue without notifying downstream
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. Cancellation while draining releases the remaining inners and discards queued work without completion.

rules.guard: matching final inner and empty queue
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. The result completes only when the outer has completed and all admitted inner work, including any queue, is finished. The final cleanup order follows this operator family under the post-setup profile.

rules.nextState: outer done; preserve active inners and queued values
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. Outer completion stops new arrivals but does not cancel the current inner work. Keep forwarding inner values and, where applicable, draining the queue.

rules.guard: no active inner and empty queue
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. If the outer completes with no inner work left, complete immediately and release the outer subscription.

actions: release the outer and active inners; discard the queue
rules.explanation: Exact exhaust = exhaustAll alias. An outer error is forwarded immediately. Unlike completion, it cancels active inners and discards queued values.
